item.description:
1.1.18 — Your member card

  • Every Pane member now gets a card of their own: a one-of-a-kind pattern and colors, your name, when you joined and your member number.
  • Make yours in Settings › Membership (new installs make it during the welcome) and watch it come to life. Hover over it and it tilts toward you.
  • Make a new design any time, or save your card as an image to share.

1.1.17 — A real assistant

  • Pane now looks things up before it answers: it searches the web, reads the top pages (prices and dates included), and answers with sources you can click.
  • Ask it to "pull up the page" and it opens the right one — the venue or official seller for tickets.
  • Follow-up questions stay on topic.
  • New: use OpenAI for smarter answers. Add your API key in Settings › Assistant (it's kept in your Keychain), or keep the free, private on-device model.

1.1.16 — A little glow

  • The New Tab box glows with a soft rainbow edge while you type.
  • While Pane is answering, the page's edge glows and gently pulses, and the box you asked from lights up.
  • Small touches: the greeting sharpens in, site tiles pop in, sparkles pulse while Pane thinks, and tab icons lift when you hover them.
